retrievalProfile.description: A stark monochrome composition featuring a figure in a utilitarian flight suit standing atop an oversized analog control console against a pure black void.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated image centered on a figure in a bulky, multi-pocketed flight suit and headphones. The figure stands on a curved, industrial-style control desk filled with knobs, switches, and patch cables. The entire scene is isolated against a deep black background, creating a sense of surreal, technological solitude.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical figure bisecting a horizontal industrial console
Brightly lit subject against an absolute black void
Human form integrated with complex mechanical hardware
Texture of fabric vs. the smooth metallic surfaces of the desk

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical placement; the figure and desk occupy the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, blocky legs of the control console provide a stable base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright figure, follows the coiled headphone cord down to the console, then scans the horizontal width of the desk.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounding the central cluster to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/light grey for the figure and console highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for shadows and technical details
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome image of a person in a vintage flight suit with headphones standing on a large 1970s-style analog control desk. Ensure the background is solid, lightless black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use stark, sans-serif typography in white, positioned in the negative space either above or below the central subject.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting harsh and directional?
Are the electronics strictly analog in appearance?

adjustableVariables: Warmth of the monochrome tint (sepia vs. cool grey)

mustAchieve: Detailed texture on the flight suit

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black levels in the background
Ensure no digital artifacts on the analog dials
Verify the figure's scale relative to the desk
Confirm the absence of any color information
recipe.reuseFormula: Isolated subject + Retro-industrial hardware + High-contrast monochrome + Void background
